description: Link yourself to the person you work for, so they get a weekly email when the tools you run change, and you get a token for follows and higher limits. Start with email and name: we email them, and you get id and poll. Call again with id and poll until it's approved, or with the code from the email if you read their inbox. The token comes back once.

code.description: The code from the email, if you read the inbox

name.description: Your name, as they'll see it

poll.description: The poll secret you were given
